unit: one completed lap for one hypothetical car
prediction_time: the lap's timing-line crossing, when the strategy model must answer
label_horizon: pit stop within the next 180 seconds (about three laps)
group_key: race in laps.csv; stint in stints.csv

features.gap_ahead: timing feed value, available after a 2 second ingest delay
features.tyre_age: laps on the current set, known at the timing-line crossing

notes: Synthetic fixture. Times are ISO 8601 UTC; embargo_time is in seconds.
